name: armis-knowledge-skills-dev
description: DEV environment (knowledge-api.moose-dev.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /cwe-fix-report-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, and /tech-guidance-dev as shell skills that call the backend directly. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID and ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on demand. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
